native.query: SELECT customer_state, avg(freight_ratio) AS avg_freight_ratio, sum(total_freight_value) AS total_freight_value, count() AS order_count FROM fct_orders WHERE 1=1 [[AND {{month}}]] [[AND {{customer_state}}]] GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY avg_freight_ratio DESC

description: Insight 2 - logistics cost by geography: average freight_ratio, total freight value, and order count per customer_state; filterable by month and customer_state. Reads fct_orders.
name: Freight Ratio by Customer State
